summary.background: To accomplish study purposes, 169 response samples from 85 project groups which drive the local industry promotion project were verified using SPSS 12.0.
summary.method: To analyze the operation planning for performance management of local industry promotion project, this study redesigns the so-called PDCA(Plan ${\rightarrow}$ Do ${\rightarrow}$ Check ${\rightarrow}$ Act) model which is also known as Deming Cycle and verifies some hypotheses.

summary_ko.result: 이러한 결과에 기초하여 연구 결과의 함의와 한계에 대해 논의하고, 향후 연구에 대한 제언을 제공하였다.
